character: Wide, modern circuit with extensive run-off (blue/red asphalt in place of gravel) and the very long Mistral Straight bisected by an optional chicane. Rewards aero efficiency and braking stability.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article.circuit-guide-paul-ricard official F1/circuit character; Signes-Beausset naming well documented

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Firm braking, late apex to set up the run through the following corners
corners.trap: Using too much of the wide run-off and carrying an unrealistic entry speed

corners.name: Signes-Beausset
corners.technique: Minimal lift, smooth steering, trust the grip through this high-speed section
corners.trap: Lifting or correcting mid-corner scrubs significant speed before the Mistral straight

corners.name: Mistral Straight Chicane
corners.technique: Hard, late braking from top speed if the chicane is in use, precise through the direction change
corners.trap: Misjudging braking distance from the very high straight-line speed

corners.name: Turn 8
corners.type: final chicane before the pit straight
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit is critical — feeds the start/finish straight
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
